title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adjusting the Jurisdictional Areas of Wuhan and Shanghai Maritime Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Adjusting the Jurisdiction Areas of Wuhan and Shanghai Maritime Courts

Fa (Si) Fa [1987] No. 39

Wuhan and Shanghai Maritime Courts:

In order to meet the needs of the further development, utilization, and opening up of the Yangtze River, upon study, it is decided to adjust the jurisdiction areas of the Wuhan Maritime Court and the Shanghai Maritime Court over the main stem of the Yangtze River. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. The jurisdiction area of the Wuhan Maritime Court shall be: the main stem of the Yangtze River from Lanjiatuo, Sichuan to Liuhekou, Jiangsu, including the major ports of Chongqing, Fuling, Wanxian, Yichang, Zhijiang, Shashi, Chenglingji, Wuhan, Huangshi, Jiujiang, Anqing, Tongling, Wuhu, Ma'anshan, Nanjing, Zhenjiang, Jiangyin, Zhangjiagang, Nantong, and others; the area below Liuhekou shall remain under the jurisdiction of the Shanghai Maritime Court.

2. The scope of cases accepted by the six maritime courts including Wuhan shall continue to implement the provisions of Document (84) Fa Si Zi No. 146 of the Supreme People's Court, accepting 18 categories of maritime and maritime commerce cases.

3. For maritime and maritime commerce cases occurring in the waters from Zhangjiagang to Liuhekou, if the lawsuit is filed before August 15, 1987, the case shall still be accepted by the Shanghai Maritime Court, with the Shanghai High People's Court as the court of second instance; if the lawsuit is filed after August 16, 1987, the case shall be accepted by the Wuhan Maritime Court, with the Hubei High People's Court as the court of second instance.

This notice is hereby given.

July 28, 1987
